deviations_from_card: project/dev/showcase/reel_director.gd NOT changed. The reel is launched as arena.tscn --bot=reel, and ReelDirector is a hook, not the entry. A RUN_TICKS const there would only be read if the runner kept a --bot -> hook map, which is the kind of central list the coordinator_note forbids. The value would also copy ReelChapters' per-chapter ticks (length() sums them at runtime, and --chapter changes it), so it would drift. And it would raise the dev_loc debt metric, which needs --accept-regression. RUN_TICKS derivation is built and tested against fixtures/reel.gd (acceptance 3). The flag spec is read only from the entry's own script (a scene's root script, or the -s script), from const KNOWN_FLAGS or const KNOWN. The card's "*_args.gd helper" fallback and following a load() of a runner script were not built: an entry like rig_bench.gd, which loads rig_bench_run.gd, reports "flags unchecked: no declared spec". AGENTS.md and docs/decisions.md were not edited (coordinator-owned); the lines are in shared_lines. Added tools/selftest/run.test.mjs (a test file outside the write set, allowed as tests). Runner options parsed by run.mjs: --windowed, --timeout=<s>, --result=<file>, --dry-run. Engine options placed before the scene: --quit-after, --fixed-fps. These are run.mjs's own CLI, not game flags.
